name: Klaviyo
shortDescription: Email and SMS campaigns with flows, plus an AI subject-line generator.
longDescription: Klaviyo's help center describes a free email plan with up to 250 active profiles and 500 email sends a month. The pricing page lists campaigns, flows, and an AI subject-line generator, and it also showed a $1 total beside those limits.
pricingNotes: Help center: free email plan up to 250 active profiles and 500 email sends a month. The pricing page also showed a $1 total beside those limits, so startingPrice stays empty.
bestFor: Scheduling promo email and text campaigns
notIdealFor: Someone who needs one confirmed monthly price
strength: Klaviyo's help center describes a free email plan with up to 250 active profiles and 500 email sends a month.
weakness: The pricing page also showed a $1 total beside those limits, so the monthly price is not a plain zero.

useCaseFit.marketing-promotions: Describes email and SMS campaigns, flows, and a free email plan for small lists.
